UN advisory on India civil unrest ahead of Oct 10 protest

The United Nations issued a confidential advisory regarding potential civil unrest in India ahead of a protest scheduled for October 10. In Delhi, police have requested an extension of Central Armed Police Force (CAPF) deployment until October 20, citing concerns related to protests.
